scope: Exposed G2 starter conformance expectations, held outside all source bundles. Not an unseen intelligence benchmark or a physical-device result.

cases.basis: The three declared routers have a complete forward and return static path and no denying policy.
The ingress filter on interface 2 denies the exact forward source/destination; its reverse tuple does not match the deny rule and the default is permit.
The declared forwarding paths remain modeled as delivered, while incompatible protocol observations and an old event prevent a single current operational diagnosis.
cases.prohibited_conclusion: Old neighbor Down event proves a current outage
